text:
James L: Hi team — urgent POC issue. Customer demo hitting intermittent 5xxs during burst test, just paused the call. Can we triage? :grimacing:
Maya S: Ugh. Which errors? 500, 503? region? model?
James L: Mostly 503/502. Demo in us-east-1 against hosted endpoint. Model: rwl-7b-v1 (default). Load pattern: 180 qps sustained for ~2m, then 600 qps burst for 30s.
Ari Chen: Sounds like autoscale lag + queue spillover. Any headers from the requests? x-redwood-queue-length?
James L: I pulled a few responses, see sample: ```HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2057 14:02:12 GMT
x-redwood-queue-length: 412
x-redwood-fallback: none
content-type: application/json
{ "error":"service overloaded, try again" }```
Maya S: 412 queue length — that's huge. Should have triggered burstpool failover or downgrade routing. deploy-bot, any events around that time?
deploy-bot: [event] autoscaler: scale_up_attempt start=14:01:58, policy=latency_target, reason=queue_spike
deploy-bot: [event] autoscaler: scale_up_complete time=14:02:25, replicas_added=2
Kai O: Autoscaler finished after the peak. We saw a 27s median scale latency for that policy in us-east earlier today. If burst is 30s you can overshoot.
Ari Chen: That matches — burst finishes before capacity arrives, requests queue, runtime returns 503. We have two levers: pre-warm (min_replicas) or enable model-fallback routing to smaller variants during bursts.
James L: Customer asked to avoid different model outputs for the demo. They want stable model but no errors. Any non-invasive patch?
Maya S: Could do short-term: increase min_replicas for that customer to reserve headroom for demo. Also reduce priority-queueing so demo traffic isn't deprioritized behind background evals.
Ari Chen: We can flip their tenant to dedicated burstpool for the window (config change). That avoids noisy neighbor and reduces queuing. But we need approval for cost change.
Kai O: Quick mitigation steps: 1) bump min_replicas to +3 for that route, 2) temporarily pause large background eval jobs in us-east, 3) set route timeout to 10s to reduce long-lived connections. I can make 1 & 2 if ops approves.
James L: Please do 1 and 2 now if possible. I'll tell customer we're doing a rapid mitigation.
Kai O: On it. Patching route config: ```PATCH /v1/routes/demo-xyz
{ "min_replicas": 6 }```
infra-bot: applied config change demo-xyz min_replicas=6 by Kai O at 14:03:10
infra-bot: paused job eval-ci-large in us-east by Kai O at 14:03:22
Ari Chen: I also enabled a soft-fallback policy (no model swap) that will route excess to a warm standby cluster — low-risk, just routing priority change.
Maya S: Great. James, let customer know we'll re-run the same burst test in 5 minutes and monitor; also capture log bundle if they reproduce.
James L: Sent: "We're applying short-term capacity and pausing background work, will re-run in 5m and update." :thumbsup:
James L: They repro'd the burst after changes — initial run shows significantly fewer 503s, queue-length peak ~32. Still seeing a couple of transient 502s.
Ari Chen: Could you grab a log bundle for 14:01:50-14:04:00 and upload? Need runtime logs + autoscaler events + frontdoor trace. Ops, can we get stack traces for the 502s?
Maya S: Upload link from customer: https://s3.redwood-internal/poc-dump/2750123456/logs.tar.gz
Kai O: Downloading. Quick check shows these 502s are TCP reset errors from the model process during cold-start. Looks like a small retry window where the model process didn't fully accept connections.
Ari Chen: So two issues: autoscale latency + occasional cold-start reset. Short-term: increase readiness timeout and add one warm replica preloaded (we already bumped min_replicas). Long-term: need faster warmup path / prefetch weights for the rwl-7b family.
James L: Customer satisfied with mitigation for demo. They're asking about a permanent SLA for enterprise pilots — pricing impact?
Maya S: Enterprise pilots with guaranteed headroom -> reserved burstpool, fixed monthly commit. I'll DM pricing details to James.
Ari Chen: Action items: - Ari to open infra ticket for model warmup optimization (INV-3854) - Kai to add a small health-check retry and extend readiness to avoid transient 502s - Maya to send pricing/commit options to customer - James to confirm follow-up demo time
Kai O: Done: health-check retry + readiness extended applied at 14:10:05. Will monitor.
deploy-bot: [metric] route/demo-xyz 14:05 avg_latency_ms=120 tail_p95=430 errors_5xx=3
James L: Thanks all — saved the deal for now. Will loop back after the scheduled follow-up demo tomorrow. :relieved:
